1. Um jogador cria a sala, escolhe as ex: 1. One player creates the room and picks the expansions (Family, Spicy, Dark humor), the number of rounds (3 to 15) and the timers.
2. O anfitrião decide se a sala tem senh: 2. The host decides whether the room has a password. With a password, the game generates 4 digits to share with friends; without one, anyone who finds the room can join. Over Wi-Fi, everyone on the same network (or on the host's hotspot) sees the room in a list. Over Bluetooth, players pick the host's room from a list (only devices running the game show up). Online, rooms appear in a public list (you need to set the server address in the menu).
3. Em cada rodada o jogo sorteia uma car: 3. Each round the game draws a black card with a blank (____). Each player picks, from their 7 white cards, the one that best completes the sentence. Cards never repeat during a match.
4. Quando o tempo acaba, as respostas ap: 4. When time runs out, the answers appear anonymously, one at a time. Give each one a rating from 1 to 5 (except your own).
5. Os pontos de cada jogador são a soma: 5. Each player's points are the sum of the ratings they received. After the last round, everyone's ranking is shown.
O anfitrião escolhe o máximo de jogadore: The host chooses the maximum number of players (2 to 20) and, before the match starts, can kick someone with the "Kick" button in the room list.
Se quiser, escolha uma foto de perfil da: If you like, pick a profile photo from your gallery on the main menu. The host can turn off photos in the room.
Termos de uso: o modo Humor negro é para: Terms of use: Dark humor mode is for adults aged 18 and over. The content is humor and fiction and does not represent anyone's opinion. By choosing to play, you agree not to be offended. Do not use the game to offend or harass real people; the host can kick anyone who disrespects the room.
O botão de pausa (II) fica no canto da t: The pause button (II) sits in the corner of the screen during the game and lets you leave the match. Pausing only affects your device: the match keeps going for everyone else.
